title: EngagementRewardGrantedPayload
description: Payload of `engagement.reward.granted` version 1: a reward was granted once for what the customer did, from its campaign's budget: promotional Wallet credit with its funder as payer, or an offer held for the customer that the basket prices. Payouts charges a Partner's share of credit to the Location whose order earned it, under "Rewards you paid for"; the customer is told once by push where they consented. The envelope's `partner_id` is the Partner paying a share, `null` when the platform pays it all. Consumers must ignore fields they do not know; new optional fields are an additive change.

source.description: What granted it: a reward `campaign`, or a city's `referral` programme.

campaign_id.description: The reward campaign; `null` for a referral.

campaign_name.description: The campaign's name, or the city's referrals.

kind.description: The campaign's kind; `null` for a referral.

rules_version.description: The version of the rules it came from.

customer_id.description: The customer (a user id); fetch personal data from the API when it is needed.

paid_as.description: How it reaches the customer: promotional Wallet credit, or an offer held for them that the basket prices.

amount.description: The credit, or the most the held offer can take off, which the budget is debited.

partner_share.description: The Partner's share, charged to the Location whose order earned it.

partner_id.description: The Partner paying a share; the envelope's `partner_id` too.

location_id.description: The Location whose order earned it.

examples: ₹150.00 of credit, from Try something new, funded by ZippyGo

expires_at.description: When a held offer ends; `null` for credit, which does not expire.

deferred_by.description: The cap that deferred it to this day, when one did.

money.description: An amount in minor units with its ISO 4217 currency.

minor_units.description: The amount in the currency's minor unit.
